correctness.rationale: Conditional on copy/refresh randomness, the nonconstant part of the count is half a sum of degree-two Rademacher characters with nonnegative multiplicities. Different unordered pairs are orthogonal, while double-refresh witnesses have unique pairs indexed by the smaller time and occur with probability epsilon^2. Total variance gives the claim; no infinite sum or stationarity is involved. At complete refresh the time-edge forest gives independent fair edge products, hence equality and the Bernoulli CLT. For 0<epsilon<1 the cited graph and time-zero initialization agree, and with T=L+d the cited sample mean is R_L/L. The bound excludes the O(log L) alternative and gives (log T)/T^2=o(Var(S_T)), exactly the unthinned theorem's premise. It also supplies the stated limiting variance floor. The corrected RESULT retains this proof; the frozen checker and recorded tests are corroboration only and were inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: The coefficient for 0<epsilon<1 is not claimed optimal. The asymptotics use the cited theorem; there is no separate computational or formal-proof attestation.
